title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer (AI Infrastructure)


Location: Chiswick, London (3 days onsite)

Salary: Up to £80,000 + Benefits

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite, potential for flexibility)


The Opportunity

We're partnering with an innovative sports betting business looking to hire a DevOps Engineer to play a key role in building, securing, and scaling modern cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on AI-driven platforms and agent-based systems.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Kubernetes, and AI infrastructure, helping deliver highly available, secure, and scalable environments that support both customer-facing betting products and next-generation AI solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain cloud-native infrastructure within AWS.
  • Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Deploy, manage and optimise Kubernetes environments.
  • Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks and monitoring solutions.
  • Ensure infrastructure meets security, compliance and reliability standards.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to support software delivery.
  • Design, build, secure, test and deploy AI agents and agent-based platforms.
  • Support the integration and operationalisation of AWS Bedrock and other AI services.
  • Drive best practices around observability, resilience, performance and disaster recovery.


Essential Experience

  • Strong commercial experience with AWS cloud technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock or similar enterprise AI platforms.
  • Expertise in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience managing production Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience building, securing, testing and deploying AI agents or agent-based applications.
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
  • Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker.
  • Understanding of cloud security, networking and monitoring.


Nice to Have

  • Experience within the sports betting, gambling, iGaming or sportsbook industry.
  • Knowledge of LLMOps, AI governance and model deployment frameworks.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Helm or similar tooling.
  • Exposure to data platforms, MLOps or machine learning infrastructure.
  • Experience operating highly regulated or high-availability platforms.


Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who combines strong DevOps fundamentals with a genuine interest in emerging AI technologies. You'll be comfortable taking ownership of cloud infrastructure, driving automation, and ensuring AI-powered systems are secure, scalable and production-ready.


Benefits

  • Salary up to £80,000 + Bonus
  • Hybrid working model
  • Potential flexibility for exceptional candidates
  • Opportunity to shape AI infrastructure strategy
  • Work within a fast-moving and innovative sports betting environment
  • Career progression within a growing technology team

RSG Plc is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.
